title: Patient Payment Plan Agreement Terms: Interest, Down Payment, Due Day and Changes to Terms
content:
**Patient Payment Plan agreement — repayment terms**

**Section 1. Interest.** No interest is charged where the tier's annual interest rate is 0.

**Section 2. Down payment.** The down payment is the greater of the tier's down payment percentage of the enrolled balance (rounded to the cent) and the tier's smallest down payment, or 0.00 where the tier's down payment percentage is 0. It is taken at signing where the tier takes the down payment at signing.

**Section 3. Monthly installment (retired clause).** The clause reading "the monthly installment is the remaining balance divided by the number of installments, rounded up to the next cent, but never below the smallest monthly installment; when the minimum applies the number of installments is the remaining balance divided by the smallest monthly installment, rounded up" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of the Patient Payment Plan.

**Section 4. Due day.** The due day is one of the tier's due-day choices, and the first installment falls on the first chosen due day at least the tier's first-due lead (in calendar days) after signing.

**Section 5. Changes to terms.** Where the tier allows modification, the patient may change the installment and the term up to the tier's limit of modifications per plan, never going below the tier's smallest monthly installment. The former limit "never adding more than the tier's maximum term extension to the number of installments" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis.

The tier figures named in these sections are those of Schedule A and of the plan change allowances of the Patient Payment Plan tiers.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Down payment under Section 2, for a hypothetical tier with a 10 percent down payment and a 75.00 smallest down payment:

| Enrolled balance | Percentage of the balance, rounded to the cent | Smallest down payment | Down payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1200.00 | 120.00 | 75.00 | 120.00 (the greater) |
| 700.00 | 70.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 (the greater) |
| 1234.56 | 123.46 (from 123.456) | 75.00 | 123.46 |

For a hypothetical tier whose percentage is 0, the down payment is 0.00 whatever the balance.

First installment under Section 4, with a hypothetical first-due lead of 30 calendar days:

| Signing date | Earliest date 30 days after signing | Chosen due day | First installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-10 | 2026-04-09 | 15th | 2026-04-15 |
| 2026-03-10 | 2026-04-09 | 1st | 2026-05-01 |
| 2026-03-16 | 2026-04-15 | 15th | 2026-04-15 (exactly 30 days; "at least" is met) |

superseded_clauses: never adding more than max_term_extension_months to term_months

The monthly installment is the remaining balance divided by term_months, rounded up to the next cent, but never below min_monthly_payment; when the minimum applies the number of installments is the remaining balance divided by min_monthly_payment, rounded up.
